chapter: Germany, Paris and return to America
title: Touring Germany with local bands; the 1963 Koblenz festival
summary: Waters played clubs with local bands and big tours with an English singer. He did not play the 1963 Koblenz expatriate festival but did a large festival with 15,000 people.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: PS: But you were plannin' to come back to the States.
Yeah, I bought it for that. It's a license, I forget what they call that license, it's a name for it, see, that you can carry it to the States without paying taxes.
PS: You did three and a half years playing with local bands wherever you were playing, in the Germany -

[ ] quite a few tours and I played all the clubs up there. I did two major tours with [ ], an English singer. And Merry Tales [?], which I just did the Merry Tales television show last year, with the same Merry Tales - a big tour, [ ] a talk show. And I did - like it was something, I did clubs. When I did clubs I'd do cities the same way I'm doing now, with locals at that particular club. It wouldn't be my mind, it would be a band hired by the manager, just like I'm doing with you.
PS: Right. On January 3rd, 1963 there was a festival in Koblenz, Germany of American expatriate musicians. Were you aware of that event, were you invited to it?
No, I never thought, I never ever played that particular event.
PS: You don't know about that event, you know, they had -
Yes. Yeah, I know about those events, most of those events -
PS: No, I'm talking about one specific one, they had that one where they got Bud Powell and Nelson Williams and Champion Jack Dupree -
No. I had heard about it but I wasn't in it.

The only festivals that I did during that period was the [ ], I did that festival, see, around that period, Combiens les Tours [?]. That's a big festival at that - they had about 15,000 people in two days.
